description: This file is a shell script that manages Wi-Fi interfaces, hostapd services, network bridging, DHCP configuration, and other network-related setup tasks for a router. It contains functions to restart hostapd on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, modifies configuration files, manages network interfaces, and performs various network setup steps.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi interface by stopping existing processes and starting hostapd with its configuration file.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 5 GHz Wi-Fi interface by removing and reloading kernel modules and starting hostapd with its configuration.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service for the 2.4 GHz interface, similar to Restart_Hostapd, ensuring Wi-Fi AP is active.
